titre: Le marché américain du médicament continue de grossir
sous_titre: Croissance annuelle des dépenses de médicaments de ville aux États-Unis, en %, 2023 à 2026

series.nom: Croissance annuelle des dépenses en médicaments de ville

2023.texte: Retail prescription drug spending increased 7.9 percent to $467.0 billion in 2024, compared to an increase of 10.8 percent in 2023.

2024.texte: Retail prescription drug spending increased 7.9 percent to $467.0 billion in 2024

2025 (prévision).texte: Retail prescription drug spending is projected to grow 11.1 percent in 2025, up from 7.9 percent in 2024 and to reach $518.7 billion.

2026 (prévision).texte: Retail prescription drug spending is expected to slow to 8.2 percent due to lower, but still strong expected growth in utilization.
